What India Asks an Astrologer

What 2,330 real consultations on Astrowani, from June to November 2026, show about who asks, what they ask about, and when.

Five findings

  1. Love comes first. 35% of chats mention love or a relationship and 22% mention marriage. Career is third, at 14%.
  2. India types in Hinglish. 90% of chats are written in Hindi using English letters.
  3. About 7 in 10 people who consult are women (69%).
  4. Most are young and single: 64% are 18–27, and 75% are unmarried.
  5. The busiest hour is noon. Sunday is the busiest day and Tuesday the quietest. 9% of consultations happen between 11 pm and 3 am.

How this was measured

Every finished consultation between 15 June and 16 November 2026 that lasted between one minute and twelve hours: 2,330 consultations by 1,410 people. Test and review accounts are excluded.

Topics and language come from chat consultations only (calls are not recorded for this). They are keyword counts in English, Hinglish and Hindi, so they are approximate: a chat about a job that never says "job" is not counted.

Privacy: only totals were taken from our records — no names, phone numbers or messages. No message is quoted here, and any group of fewer than 20 people or consultations is left out.

Some smaller groups are not shown for that reason.

Using this data: you are welcome to quote these figures, with a link to this page.
